skill.name: building-skills
skill.description: Expert guidance for creating, validating, and maintaining Claude Code skills. Use when designing SKILL.md files, choosing skill versus agent or command architecture, setting allowed-tools, adding templates or references, or checking skill schema and security conventions.
skill.summary: Create, validate, and maintain Claude Code skills with structured templates and permission guidance.

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code examples, example paths, and validator messages. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious command execution was found. The remaining concern is broad pre-approved Write, Edit, and Bash access in a community skill.

remediation.issue: Broad Write, Edit, and Bash permissions in skill frontmatter.
remediation.suggestion: Reduce allowed-tools to the minimum needed, and require explicit user confirmation for shell commands or broad file edits when possible.

semantic_findings.title: Broad Pre-Approved Tool Permissions
semantic_findings.description: The skill frontmatter grants Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, and Bash. For a community skill that can auto-invoke during skill creation, these permissions increase the impact of mistaken activation or future instruction changes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed-tools declaration is explicit, and the skill documentation states these permissions are pre-approved. The content is legitimate, but the permission scope is broader than needed for many guidance tasks.

content.value_statement: Creating reliable AI skills requires clear triggers, safe permissions, and valid structure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users through design, validation, and maintenance.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to choose skills, agents, or commands for Claude Code workflows.
Documents required SKILL.md frontmatter and skill directory structure.
Provides guidance for allowed-tools formatting and permission selection.
Includes a reusable skill template with sections for capabilities, triggers, resources, and examples.
Includes a Python validator for names, YAML frontmatter, descriptions, tools, and resource references.
Offers maintenance guidance for removing invalid model fields and improving auto-invocation.
limitations: It focuses on Claude Code skill conventions and may not match other agent platforms.
The validator checks structure and metadata, not full runtime safety.
Generated skills still need human review before use with write or shell permissions.
It does not publish, install, or certify marketplace submissions by itself.

use_cases.title: Create a New Skill
use_cases.description: Plan a skill directory, write SKILL.md guidance, choose resources, and validate the result before use.

use_cases.title: Standardize Existing Skills
use_cases.description: Review frontmatter, naming, descriptions, allowed-tools, and resource references against Claude Code conventions.

use_cases.title: Audit Skill Architecture
use_cases.description: Decide whether a workflow should be a skill, agent, or command, then document the right structure.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Claude Code skill for [domain]. Include a clear name, auto-invocation description, capabilities, and basic resource sections.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Skill Directory
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill directory for schema issues, unclear triggers, risky permissions, missing resources, and invalid frontmatter.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Auto-Invocation
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this skill description so Claude invokes it only for the right tasks. Keep it specific and under the schema limit.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Skill System
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this workflow, decide which parts should be skills, agents, or commands. Explain the directory structure and permission model.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing Terraform plans.
output_examples.output: A proposed skill name, trigger-focused description, capability list, resource plan, and validation checklist for Terraform review workflows.

output_examples.input: Check why my skill is not loading.
output_examples.output: A review of frontmatter, file placement, naming, description clarity, resource paths, and allowed-tools formatting.

output_examples.input: Should this workflow be a skill or an agent?
output_examples.output: A recommendation based on invocation style, context needs, isolation, resource usage, and expected user control.

best_practices: Write descriptions that state exactly when the skill should activate.
Keep allowed-tools minimal and add write or shell access only when required.
Validate SKILL.md, resource paths, and examples before sharing a skill.
anti_patterns: Do not add a model field to skill frontmatter.
Do not use vague descriptions that apply to many unrelated tasks.
Do not grant Bash or write permissions for read-only guidance skills.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps create, validate, and maintain Claude Code skills with correct structure, triggers, resources, and permissions.

faq.question: Can it decide between a skill, agent, and command?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when automatic skill behavior is better than explicit agents or command workflows.

faq.question: Does it include a validator?
faq.answer: Yes. The included Python script checks SKILL.md frontmatter, naming, descriptions, allowed-tools, and common structure issues.

faq.question: Does it guarantee a skill is safe?
faq.answer: No. It provides structural checks and safety guidance, but humans must review permissions and script behavior.

faq.question: Can Codex users use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support, but the guidance targets Claude Code skill conventions.

faq.question: When should I avoid this skill?
faq.answer: Avoid it for workflows that need explicit invocation, isolated context, or platform features outside Claude Code skill rules.
